title: Hultafors Group North America Recalls Lighted Portfolios, Angle Locators, Calipers and Calculators Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Battery Ingestion; Violate Mandatory Standard for Consumer Products with Button Cell Batteries
hazard: The various trade tools violate the mandatory safety standard for consumer products with button cell and coin batteries because the button batteries can be accessed easily by children, posing an ingestion hazard. Additionally, the packaging and product do not have the warnings required under Reese’s Law. When button cell or coin batteries are swallowed, the ingested batteries can cause serious injuries, internal chemical burns and death.
description: This recall involves CLC Lighted Portfolio & Johnson Level Digital Angle Locator, Digital Caliper and Building Calculator, with the model numbers located on the unit and the package labeling. The following models, UPC Codes and retail prices are included in this recall.
remedy:
Consumers should stop using the recalled trade tools immediately, place them in an area inaccessible to children and contact Hultafors Group North America. To obtain a refund, consumers will be asked to upload a photograph of the product at  www.HG2026.expertinquiry.com and certify that the product has been disposed of and will no longer be used. Upon verification, consumers will receive the retail price, as shown in table below in the form of a virtual Visa gift card. The virtual Visa gift card may be redeemed at any establishment that accepts Visa.

Note: Button cell batteries are hazardous. Batteries should be disposed of or recycled by following local hazardous waste procedures.
manufacturer: Hultafors Group North America, Inc., of Mequon, Wisconsin

title: CHE-US Recalls Magnetic Robot Toys Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Magnet Ingestion; Violate Mandatory Standard for Toys
hazard: The recalled magnetic stick figures violate the mandatory standard for toys because when pulled apart, the figures’ arms and legs liberate high-powered magnets posing an ingestion hazard to children. When high-powered magnets are swallowed, the ingested magnets can attract each other, or other metal objects, and become lodged in the digestive system. This can result in perforations, twisting, and/or blockage of the intestines, blood poisoning and death.
description: This recall involves CHE-US magnetic stick figure toys. The robot-shaped toys were sold in sets of five or 10 purple, blue, yellow, red and green stick figures. Each stick figure has four small magnets, one in each hand and foot. “X004N3MGCB” is printed on the back of the product packaging.
remedy: Consumers should stop using the stick figures immediately, take them away from children and contact CHE-US for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to send a photo of the toys in the trash to CHE-USMagneticRobotToysRecall@outlook.com. Consumers should then dispose of the recalled product.

title: Ororo Recalls Rechargeable Lithium-Ion Battery Packs Due to Risk of Serious Injury from Fire and Burn Hazards
hazard: The recalled lithium-ion battery packs can overheat, posing a risk of serious injury from fire and burn hazards.
description: This recall involves ororo’s rechargeable lithium-ion battery packs, model PD10K-Pro. The black battery packs have a built-in USB-C cable and a digital display. “ororo” is written on the front of the battery pack. The model and a seven alphanumeric serial number starting with 67U, 685, 686 or 68A is printed on the back.
remedy:
Consumers should stop using the battery packs immediately and contact ororo for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to go to Ororowear.com/pd10k-pro-recall to register and to receive disposal instructions. Once registered, consumers should dispose of the recalled battery packs in accordance with local and state regulations.  

Note: Do not throw this recalled lithium-ion battery or device in the trash, the general recycling stream (e.g., street-level or curbside recycling bins), or used battery recycling boxes found at various retail and home improvement stores. Recalled lithium-ion batteries must be disposed of differently than other batteries, because they present a greater risk of fire. Your municipal household hazardous waste (HHW) collection center may accept this recalled lithium-ion battery or device for disposal. Before taking your battery or device to a HHW collection center, contact that office ahead of time and ask whether it accepts recalled lithium-ion batteries. If it does not, contact your municipality for further guidance.

title: Electrical Appliances: - Alimentation électrique AC DC 3V 9V 12V 24V 36V 2A 3A 5A 10A, transformateur d'éclairage 220V à 12
hazard: Electric_Shock, Fire. The creepage and clearance distances of the electrical circuit of the device and its insulation are inadequate. Live parts may become accessible, and the user could receive an electric shock. Moreover, this may lead to a fire.
description: Power supply, AC DC 3V 9V 12V 24V 36V 2A 3A 5A 10A, for 220V to 12V lighting transformer. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Low Voltage Directive nor with the European standards EN 61558 and EN 55032.
remedy: Removal From Online Marketplace; Warning Consumers Of Risks

title: Electrical Appliances: Electric brush
hazard: Burns. The product becomes excessively hot when connected to the power supply and may therefore cause burns.
description: White plastic electric hairbrush with an ON/OFF switch, powered by a 220 V mains supply and fitted with a black power cord. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Low Voltage Directive nor with the European standard EN 60335-1.

title: Waymo LLC: Vehicle May Fail to Remain Stopped for Traffic Control Hand Gestures
hazard: Proceeding into an intersection under manual traffic control without permission increases the risk of a crash.
description: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM Waymo LLC (Waymo) is recalling certain 5th Generation and 6th Generation Automated Driving Systems (ADS) operating a software version prior to the September 17, 2026 release. The vehicle may fail to remain stopped after initially stopping for traffic control hand gestures from law enforcement.
remedy: Waymo has updated the ADS software, free of charge. All affected vehicles were repaired by November 6, 2026.

title: Waymo LLC: Software May Allow Vehicle to Drive in Closed Lane on Freeway
hazard: Driving in a closed lane on a freeway increases the risk of a crash.
description: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM Waymo LLC (Waymo) is recalling certain 5th Generation and 6th Generation Automated Driving Systems (ADS). The software may allow the vehicle to enter a closed freeway lane and continue driving at speed.
remedy: Beginning November 11, 2026, Waymo modified the scope of operations to avoid conditions that presented an increased likelihood of encountering closed freeway lanes. The final remedy is currently under development.

title: Gillig, LLC: EV System May Switch into Neutral Unexpectedly
hazard: An unexpected switch to neutral can cause a loss of drive power and increase the risk of a crash.
description: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM Gillig, LLC (Gillig) is recalling certain 2023-2026 Low Floor electric transit buses. The EV resolver cable may lose electrical connectivity, unexpectedly switching from drive to neutral with no warning.
remedy: Gillig will replace the external resolver cable support bracket and clamp, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 14, 2026. Owners may contact Gillig's customer service at 1-800-735-1500.

title: Electrical Appliances: Girlanda
hazard: Electric_Shock. The live parts of the lamp cap are accessible when the lamp is partially screwed into the lampholder of the luminaire, leading to electric shock. Consequently, the user could touch accessible live parts and receive an electric shock.
description: LED-lighting chain. AC Mains pluggable with non-detachable power supply cord, class II, 16 A round plug. E27 lamp holders. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Low Voltage Directive and the relevant European standard EN IEC 60598.

title: Toys: Kids music turtle crab toy
hazard: Choking. The toy has small parts (label) that can easily detach. A small child could put them in the mouth and choke.
description: Musical toy in the shape of a turtle made of hard plastic, featuring buttons and light and sound effects. The toy is battery-operated. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Toy Safety Directive nor with the European standard EN 71-1.

title: Toys: Ride-on toy car
hazard:
Choking. The toy has small parts (plastic components, stickers and part of a connector) that can easily detach and break. A small child could put them in the mouth and choke.
In addition, when opening the battery compartment the screw comes completely loose, posing an additional risk of choking.
description: Ride-on toy car with a unicorn made of hard plastic with pink, brown and light blue colours. The toy is battery-operated and features light and sound effects. The product does not comply with the Toy Safety Directive nor with the European standard EN 71-1 and the European standard EN 62115.

title: Electrical Appliances: USB Charger
hazard: Electric_Shock. The dielectric strength of the USB connectors is insufficient and can cause a discharge between the primary and secondary sides, the user could receive an electric shock from accessible live parts.
description: Set of three white mains adaptors. Dimensions approximately 7 x 3 x 1.5 cm. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Low Voltage Directive.
